changelog:
## v1.1
- Added a new Saved Networks view to load and connect to previously saved Wi-Fi networks.
- Added a new Commands view to execute predefined HTTP requests and display responses.
- Updated the Font and Keyboard libraries to the latest versions.
- Removed input debouncing logic.

## v1.0
- Initial release

# FlipperHTTP App
A companion app for FlipperHTTP firmware. 

## Requirements
- Wi-Fi Developer Board, BW16, Raspberry Pi, or ESP32 device flashed with FlipperHTTP v2.2 or higher: https://github.com/jblanked/FlipperHTTP
- 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz Wi-Fi access point
